「
！」

pages.en:
“S-stop! Stay away from me…!”

Shinji flees.

The instant I reach for his back——

“——!”

A chill floods my entire body, and I instinctively snatch my arm away.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Stop, don’t come near me…!”
Shinji runs away.
The instant I reach out to his back…
“
!”
I feel a chill run through my whole body, and I quickly withdraw my extended arm.

pages.ja:
空を切る軌跡。
さっきまで俺がいた空間を断つ、黒い刃物。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
A stroke cuts through empty air.

A black blade severs the space I occupied only an instant ago.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Something cuts through the air.
A sharp black edge cuts through the space I was in a moment ago.

pages.ja:

足が止まる。
何処から現れたのか、目の前には、

pages.en:
“——…!”

My feet stop.

I do not know where she appeared from, but before me stands——
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…!”
I stop.
I don’t know where it came from, but in front of me…

pages.ja: この毒々しい赤色さえ薄れるほど、禍々しい黒色の女性がいた。
pages.jaRuby: この毒々しい赤色さえ薄れるほど、禍々しい黒色の女性がいた。
pages.en: a woman steeped in black so baleful that even the poisonous crimson around her seems pale.
pages.mirrorMoon: …Is a woman in black who makes even the red seem faint.

pages.ja:
「あ
」
理性が恐れで停止した。
殺される。
考えたくないのに、無惨に殺されている自分の姿が脳裏に浮かぶ。
それは。
先ほどの影なんて比較にもならないほど、明確な死の気配だった。

pages.en:
“Ah——”

Fear brings my reason to a halt.

She will kill me.

Against my will, an image of myself brutally murdered rises into my mind.

——This is a presence of death far clearer than anything those shadows possessed.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Ah
”
My mind stops in fear.
I’ll be killed.
I don’t want to think about it, but an image of
my head being ripped off
being brutally killed
pops into my head.
This is…
…A sense of death that the previous shadows cannot even compare to.

pages.en: “Y-yes, Rider…! Don't hold back. You can do whatever you like with him…!”
pages.mirrorMoon: “G-Good, Rider…! Don’t restrain yourself, you can do what you like with him…!”
